title: U Mass - Hemoglobin A1c Assay Protocol
author: Jason Kim
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.xy3fpyn
materials: Allow reagents and assay plate to come to room temperature. Gently remove well contents and wash plate 2x following the instructions listed in the Plate Washing section.
Add 25 µL of Detection Antibodies into each well. Allow the Detection Antibodies to warm to room temperature prior to addition.

steps.title: Initial Plate Wash
steps.instruction: Add 200 µL of Wash Buffer into each well of the plate, seal, and mix on a plate shaker for 10 minutes at room temperature (20-25°C).

steps.title: Remove Wash Buffer
steps.instruction: Decant Wash Buffer and remove residual amounts from all wells by inverting the plate and tapping it smartly onto absorbent towels several times.

steps.title: Add Standards and Controls
steps.instruction: Add 25 µL of each Standard or Control solution into the appropriate wells, using Assay Buffer for the 0 pg/mL standard (Background).

steps.title: Prepare Sample Wells
steps.instruction: Add 25 µL of Assay Buffer to the sample wells.

steps.title: Add Samples
steps.instruction: Add 25 µL of Sample (diluted one part serum or plasma to one part Assay Buffer) into the appropriate wells.

substeps.instruction: Use the provided Serum Matrix when assaying serum or plasma samples.
Use proper control culture medium as the matrix solution when assaying tissue culture or other supernatant.

steps.title: Add Magnetic Beads
steps.instruction: Vortex the Mixing Bottle and add 25 μL of the mixed or premixed beads to each well, shaking the bead bottle intermittently to avoid settling.

steps.title: Overnight Incubation
steps.instruction: Seal the plate with a plate sealer, wrap with foil, and incubate with agitation on a plate shaker overnight (18~20 hours) at 4°C.

steps.title: Room Temperature Incubation
steps.instruction: Seal, cover with foil, and incubate with agitation on a plate shaker for 1 hour at room temperature (20~25°C). Do not aspirate after incubation.

steps.title: Add Streptavidin-Phycoerythrin
steps.instruction: Add 25 µL Streptavidin-Phycoerythrin to each well containing the 25 µL of Detection Antibodies.

steps.title: Final Incubation
steps.instruction: Seal, cover with foil, and incubate with agitation on a plate shaker for 30 minutes at room temperature (20~25°C).

steps.title: Wash Plate
steps.instruction: Gently remove well contents and wash the plate 2x following the Plate Washing procedure.

substeps.instruction: Let plate soak on magnet for 60 seconds to allow complete settling of magnetic beads.
Wash plate with 200 µL/well of Wash Buffer.
Allow beads to soak for 60 seconds, then remove Wash Buffer by aspiration after each wash.
If using a Bio-Tek ELx405 plate washer for magnetic beads, follow the instructed equipment settings.

steps.title: Resuspend Beads
steps.instruction: Add 150 µL of Sheath Fluid to all wells and resuspend the beads on a plate shaker for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Run Bioplex 200
steps.instruction: Run the plate on Bioplex 200, setting parameters for 125 µl and 75 beads per bead set.

steps.title: Data Analysis
steps.instruction: Save and analyze the Median Fluorescent Intensity (MFI) data using a 5-parameter logistic or spline curve-fitting method to calculate cytokine/chemokines concentrations.

substeps.instruction: For diluted samples, multiply the calculated concentration by the dilution factor.

description: Add 25 µL of appropriate matrix solution to the background, standards, and control wells.
